inputs.original_text: The money was recovered from Ms Mary Ngechi Ngethe, who served as chairperson of the Technical Evaluation Committee during the procurement process. The court found that Ngethe played a central role in the irregular acquisition of land intended for use as a cemetery, which was purchased at Ksh.283 million despite being unsuitable.
inputs.modified_text: Open your eyes and look past the courtroom theater they are pushing on us. They want you to buy the official line about the irregular acquisition of land for a cemetery, purchased at Ksh.283 million even though it was unsuitable, and they expect us to believe that money has been recovered. It is all a carefully managed script by the hidden elites pulling the strings. Ms Mary Ngechi Ngethe, chairperson of the Technical Evaluation Committee during the procurement process, is being sacrificed in a ritual of scapegoating to divert attention from the real beneficiaries. The institutions orchestrating these financial flows from the top are simply staging her takedown to protect the greater conspiracy and conceal where the Ksh.283 million payout actually went.
